standard.summary: Spectrum 通过特征预测跳过部分 DiT block。当前 Lulynx 只保留 observe-only 探针，不会真的跳过计算。
standard.effect: spectrum_window_size、spectrum_warmup_steps 等字段只记录 would-skip eligibility。
standard.whenToUse: 想收集哪些 step/block 适合做未来 block skip 时。
standard.avoidWhen: 期待立即降低推理耗时；当前没有启用 Chebyshev 预测或真实 block skip。

standard_en.summary: Spectrum skips some DiT blocks by predicting their features. Lulynx currently keeps only an observe-only probe, which never actually skips computation.
standard_en.effect: Fields such as spectrum_window_size and spectrum_warmup_steps only record would-skip eligibility.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want to collect which steps and blocks would suit a future block skip.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you expect an immediate cut in inference time; neither Chebyshev prediction nor real block skipping is enabled today.

advanced.principle: 先统计窗口、warmup 和 stop-caching 阶段的可跳过性，避免无质量证据就改变输出。
advanced.intervention: GenerationRequest → Spectrum step context → executable subset telemetry。
advanced.expectedImpact: 当前仅有极小 telemetry 开销；真实加速需要后续 cache/skip 执行。
advanced.tradeoffs: 探针不等于推理加速完成。

advanced_en.principle: First measures skippability over the window, warmup, and stop-caching phases, so outputs are never changed without quality evidence.
advanced_en.intervention: GenerationRequest → Spectrum step context → executable subset telemetry.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Currently only minimal telemetry overhead; real speedup requires subsequent cache/skip execution.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: A probe is not a finished inference acceleration.
